## Complex problems, solved with ease

AI Models is capability. Code, analyze, sheets and slides — simplify complex work with the latest flagship model.

### Kimi K3

The new frontier of intelligence. 2.8T parameters, natively multimodal, 1M-token context — built for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and deep reasoning.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20width='17'%20height='11'%20viewBox='0%200%2017%2011'%20fill='none'%3e%3cpath%20fill-rule='evenodd'%20clip-rule='evenodd'%20d='M16.2822%205.89421C16.5733%205.60101%2016.5725%205.12762%2016.2803%204.83547L11.6649%200.220089C11.3721%20-0.0728045%2010.8972%20-0.0728045%2010.6043%200.220089C10.3114%200.512982%2010.3114%200.987855%2010.6043%201.28075L13.9393%204.6158H0.75C0.335785%204.6158%200%204.95159%200%205.3658C0%205.78002%200.335785%206.1158%200.75%206.1158H13.9485L10.6024%209.48624C10.3105%209.78019%2010.3123%2010.2551%2010.6062%2010.5469C10.9002%2010.8387%2011.375%2010.837%2011.6669%2010.5431L16.2822%205.89421Z'%20fill='white'/%3e%3c/svg%3e)[Explore Features](https://www.kimi.com/)

## Discover Kimi doodles

Explore doodles for holidays, events, and trends — each one a small surprise.

### June · Turing's Birthday

A tape defined computation. One question inspired AI. Chat with Kimi continues Turing's legacy.

### May · Bob Dylan 's Birthday

Sunglasses, guitar, harmonica. For the old rock Nobel who couldn't be bothered. The question is the answer.

### April · Earth Day

A Fauvist forest honoring Matisse’s cut-outs. Let this Doodle remind you: log off and step into spring.
